findings.highlight: It'll start Saturday night and will continue until everyone's performed.
findings.evidenceJa: 全部のステージが終わったら解散。出演順だけ決めて、あとは持ち時間も適当なんだって
findings.explanation: The performers disband once every set is over; only the order is fixed, while each act's allotted time is deliberately loose. Todokanai TL drops both defining details and leaves the quotation open, weakening the joke answered by Io on the next line.
findings.japanese:
「そ、レギュラー総出演のオールナイト！
土曜の夜から始めて全部のステージが終わったら解散。
出演順だけ決めて、あとは持ち時間も適当なんだって」
findings.todokanai: "Right, it's an all-night showing of all the regulars. It'll start Saturday night and will continue until everyone's performed.

findings.evidenceJa: わたし、ただのヘルプだし
findings.explanation: Setsuna describes herself as only a fill-in or guest helping Routes, not as a backing vocalist within the performance. 'Backup singer' assigns her a different musical role and undercuts why Tomo says she alone still sees herself as temporary.
findings.japanese:
「え？　で、でも…
わたし、ただのヘルプだし」
findings.todokanai: "Eh? B-But… I'm just a backup singer."

findings.highlight: I'll be forced to take countless days off, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 何回か休み、拘束されるよね
findings.explanation: Setsuna asks whether rehearsals will occupy several of her days off. Todokanai TL says she must take countless days off work, changing both the finite quantity and whose schedule is being consumed.
findings.japanese:
「でも、練習だってあるよね？
何回か休み、拘束されるよね？」
findings.todokanai: "But I'll have to rehearse, right? I'll be forced to take countless days off, right?"

findings.highlight: You can rehearse the rest during karaoke.
findings.evidenceJa: あとは個人練習でカバーすればさぁ
findings.explanation: Tomo says one or two group rehearsals are enough and the rest can be covered by individual practice. Karaoke is not mentioned and turns a general rehearsal plan into an invented venue/activity.
findings.japanese:
「それだって１、２回くらいいいじゃん。
あとは個人練習でカバーすればさぁ」
findings.todokanai: "Just one or two days should be enough. You can rehearse the rest during karaoke."

findings.highlight: Why won't she change for my sake…?
findings.evidenceJa: どうして、変わってくれないのかな
findings.explanation: Setsuna wonders why Tomo will not change. Todokanai TL adds 'for my sake,' converting her exhausted wish for greater understanding into a more explicitly self-centered demand.
findings.japanese: どうして、変わってくれないのかな…
findings.todokanai: Why won't she change for my sake…?

findings.highlight: he's not gonna get better just because you suffer yourself, Setsuna.
findings.evidenceJa: どれだけ雪菜が苦しんでも、彼は楽にならないよ？あの北原さんなら尚更でしょ？
findings.explanation: Tomo adds that this is especially true of Haruki, whose personality makes Setsuna's suffering still less capable of easing his own. Todokanai TL drops that pointed appeal to Haruki's character and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「彼の苦しみを引き受けてあげたいのかもしれないけど、
どれだけ雪菜が苦しんでも、彼は楽にならないよ？
あの北原さんなら尚更でしょ？」
findings.todokanai: "I understand that you want to take on all his suffering, but he's not gonna get better just because you suffer yourself, Setsuna.

findings.highlight: The gloomy dimness of my own world refuses to be chased away.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしの世界の中からは、湿っぽさも、薄暗さも未だ吹き飛んでくれてはいない
findings.explanation: Even after the rainy season, neither dampness nor dimness has cleared from Setsuna's world. Todokanai TL fuses the two into 'gloomy dimness,' deleting the dampness that has structured the chapter's weather and emotional imagery.
findings.japanese:
わたしの世界の中からは、
湿っぽさも、薄暗さも未だ吹き飛んでくれてはいない。
findings.todokanai: The gloomy dimness of my own world refuses to be chased away.
